what_was_done: Installed the declared broker proof dependencies into the local venv: alpaca-py and ib-insync.
Added scripts/broker_readiness_probe.py as a repeatable CLI for read-only broker connectivity checks.
The CLI probes IBKR paper/read-only via local TWS or IB Gateway ports and Alpaca paper via account/positions calls only.
The probe does not submit, cancel, modify, or transmit broker orders.
Added tests that verify the probe masks credential presence, handles closed IBKR ports, skips Alpaca network calls when credentials are missing, and reports read_only_no_orders safe mode.
Documented the optional broker connectivity proof in docs/BUYER_SETUP_GUIDE.md.
